title: Safety Research and the Allocation of Frontier Compute
abstract: arXiv:2610.14305v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: During a frontier takeoff period, an AI lab splits a committed stock of compute among capability research, safety research, and customers, and a regulator limits both the services customers lose and how long any capability can be delayed. Extra safety compute can then come from customers or from capability research. Funding from capability research delays the end of the takeoff period, so the cheaper source depends on how much finishing raises customer services: customers above a threshold, capability research as well below it. Customer funding leaves capability dates unchanged, while research funding gives safety knowledge more time at the cost of later capability and customer services. The threshold is evaluated at a given allocation under a common continuation. Varying the calibration shows how delay costs, additional safety learning, and service valuation move it; in the baseline, it rises with the service budget. Customer-funded

translated_title: 安全研究与前沿算力的分配
translated_abstract: 在前沿起飞期间，一个人工智能实验室将承诺的算力总量分配给能力研究、安全研究和客户，而监管机构则同时限制客户损失的服务以及任何能力可以被延迟的时间。额外的安全算力可以来自客户，也可以来自能力研究。从能力研究中抽调资金会推迟起飞期的结束，因此更廉价的资金来源取决于完成研究能在多大程度上提升客户服务：当服务水平高于某一阈值时，应从客户算力中资助；远低于该阈值时，则应从能力研究中资助。客户出资使能力发布日期保持不变，而研究出资则给安全知识更多时间，代价是能力发布和客户服务的推迟。该阈值是在给定分配方案和共同延续路径下进行评估的。改变校准参数可以显示延迟成本、额外安全学习和服务估值如何影响该阈值；在基准情形中，该阈值随服务预算的增加而上升。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文建模了前沿AI起飞期间实验室如何在能力研究与安全研究之间分配算力，表明当客户服务水平高于某阈值时应由客户算力资助安全研究、否则应从能力研究中抽调，并分析了延迟成本、额外安全学习和服务估值对这一决策阈值的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper models how an AI lab should allocate frontier compute between capability and safety research during a takeoff period, showing that extra safety compute should be funded from customers when service levels exceed a threshold and from capability research otherwise, with the threshold depending on delay costs, additional safety learning, and service valuation.
